title: Loker HITL Pending Request
description: Engine-written request for human input at runs/<id>/pending/<phase>.json (HITL design §3.3). Severity drives the default timeout ladder (low/medium/high), but workflow policy may configure any severity to have a concrete deadline or to block indefinitely. The artefact + context blocks give the UI everything it needs to render the decision page; decision_options narrows the legal verdicts the responder may pick.

run_id.description: HITL workflow slug (per HITL design §3.3, e.g. 'design-doc-tdd-2026-04-25-1437-a7c3'), not the loker.run_id UUID used by other artefacts. Kept un-namespaced and as an opaque string to preserve compatibility with the HITL spec.

timeout_at.description: Absolute deadline for this gate, or null when the effective workflow policy blocks indefinitely. Default policy writes low=1h, medium=24h, high=null; configured policies may write any severity as date-time or null.
